visual_style.visual_rules: Begin with visible space around the visitor. Narrow attention only after the discovery; return to a readable body gesture at the finish.
visual_style.palette: Muted stone and sage outside; warm wood in the room; one teal object gives the eye a destination.
visual_style.lighting: Soft side daylight outside; warm practical light by the shelf; keep the object highlight on the same side.
visual_style.wardrobe: Visitor keeps a plain rust overshirt. Maker keeps a dark top. Keep the object in the same position through its inserts.
visual_style.sound: Let footsteps introduce the film. The room becomes quiet at recognition. Finish on a deliberate breath and the table touch.

The object remains on its plinth.
Carry the eyeline into the object insert.
